statements.sql: WITH pw AS (  SELECT f.mfl_id AS m, w.week AS wk, w.team AS t    FROM nfl_player_weekly w JOIN ff_player_ids f ON f.gsis_id = w.gsis_id   WHERE w.season = ?1 AND w.week BETWEEN 1 AND 18 AND w.team IS NOT NULL AND w.team <> ''     AND f.mfl_id IS NOT NULL AND f.gsis_id NOT IN ('', 'NA')), agg AS (SELECT m, MIN(t) AS t, MIN(wk) AS lo, MAX(wk) AS hi, COUNT(DISTINCT t) AS n FROM pw GROUP BY m) SELECT m, t, lo, hi, NULL AS wk FROM agg WHERE n = 1 UNION ALL SELECT pw.m, pw.t, NULL, NULL, pw.wk FROM pw JOIN agg ON agg.m = pw.m WHERE agg.n > 1
SELECT week, team, SUM(COALESCE(rush_att,0)+COALESCE(pass_att,0)+COALESCE(pass_sacks,0)) AS plays FROM nfl_player_weekly WHERE season = ?1 AND week BETWEEN 1 AND 18 GROUP BY week, team
SELECT team, off_plays_pg, def_plays_pg FROM nfl_team_pace WHERE season = ?1
